rawInput.answer: Application-level route handling is wired in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily instantiates `this.router` as a `new Router(...)`, and app.use/app.route/app.param/app[method]/app.handle all delegate to `this.router` (e.g., app.handle calls `this.router.handle(req, res, done)` at line 177). The Router class itself is NOT implemented in this repo — it's imported via `var Router = require('router');` in both lib/application.js (line 26) and lib/express.js (line 19), and package.json lists `router: ^2.2.0` as a dependency; there is no lib/router directory in this repo.
